assertions.title: Error boundaries catch and display errors gracefully
assertions.summary: Source inspection confirmed a real ErrorBoundary component in app/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx that catches render failures, logs them, and renders a user-friendly fallback with retry/navigation actions. app/janus/page.tsx wraps the auth, projects, pipeline, and reference dashboard sections with that boundary, and the related unit tests passed both as a targeted run (1 file, 6 tests) and in the full frontend Vitest suite (21 files, 246 tests).

checks.expected: A real error boundary catches errors and displays graceful recovery/navigation UI.
checks.observed: ErrorBoundary uses getDerivedStateFromError (line 23) and componentDidCatch (line 27), resets state via handleRetry (line 31), and renders a fallback with role=alert plus a Try Again button and Go to Dashboard link (lines 60 and 66).

checks.expected: Major page sections are wrapped so a component crash does not blank the full dashboard.
checks.observed: ErrorBoundary wraps AuthPanel at line 529, ProjectCreatePanel + ProjectsPanel at line 548, the pipeline section panels at line 570, and ApiRoutesPanel at line 658; each wrapper provides user-facing fallback guidance.

checks.expected: Unit tests explicitly cover fallback UI plus retry/navigation behavior.
checks.observed: The file defines the relevant tests renders fallback UI when a child throws (line 32), renders custom fallback title and message (line 47), shows a Try Again button that resets the error state (line 60), shows a Go to Dashboard link (line 74), and has role=alert on the fallback container (line 85).

checks.action: Run npx vitest run app/components/__tests__/ErrorBoundary.test.tsx --reporter=verbose from E:\Janus\frontend\web
checks.observed: Exit code 0; Vitest reported 1 passed test file and 6 passed tests. Verbose output showed passes for children rendering, fallback rendering, custom fallback copy, retry reset behavior, dashboard navigation link, and role=alert coverage.

checks.action: Run npm run test from E:\Janus\frontend\web
checks.expected: The real frontend Vitest suite still passes with the ErrorBoundary coverage included.
checks.observed: Exit code 0; Vitest reported 21 passed test files and 246 passed tests in 3.74s, including app/components/__tests__/ErrorBoundary.test.tsx (6 tests).

evidence.informationalOutput: Both Vitest logs include repeated 'Error: Test crash' React stack traces from the intentional throwing child used by ErrorBoundary tests. Per frontend-cli guidance, these were treated as informational because both commands exited 0 and the suites passed.

summary: Tested 1 frontend CLI assertion: 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked. VAL-FH-021 is satisfied by the real ErrorBoundary implementation, its dashboard section wrappers, and passing targeted/full Vitest coverage.
